description: One exact hologram, many views, for .NET. The Pleroma stores items (a key plus optional flag word, arrangement and time tick) in one fixed array of finite-field harmonics and answers exact counts per key and whole items, refusing past capacity instead of answering wrongly, plus exact counts per flag word, Hamming near-counts and nearest words, counts per arrangement and per tick, opt-in joint counts over flags, order and time, and the count of items whose flag word satisfies any predicate (one read, per tick or arrangement too), all at any load. The whole store relabels flags and arrangements, shifts keys, ages and diffuses over time in place, with every view still exact, and applies a weighted superposition of flag flips, arrangement relabellings and time shifts (PleromaKernel) in one pass whose cost does not depend on how many it holds; two stores bind in one pass (keys add, flag words XOR, arrangements compose), and Attend reads one flag query three ways at once (exact counts per value, shares summing to 1, parity of the count); an opt-in complete key band adds key scaling and the Chinese-remainder join of two stores, stores without per-bit item lines take Frobenius squaring and linear shift-register steps on their flag words, and exact reads give Hamming syndrome counts, an integer independence test of joint counts and a draw from any view's exact shares; an opt-in time spectrum gives exact time-valued maps per key (each key's tick histogram, conflict detection, any map of the ticks applied in place), an opt-in relation face in the same store reads loop winding, frustration parity and the exact circulation direction of loops of rates; dense pages (complete key bands) read every slot exactly at any load, build from count vectors in one transform, sum any key predicate and the equi-join of two pages in one read, and project to smaller shadow stores; any signed permutation of the flag words applies to the stored items exactly in place (time reversal, particle-hole and chiral symmetry included); dense pages also take key modulation, per-key weights and Hadamard products, and operators have exact adjoints; restriction to a flag condition, key support (COUNT DISTINCT), pointwise maps of key counts, sums per group and joins are exact; stores of one shape share their registry, page sets hold many dense pages as contiguous cells with batched reads, key sampling and parity, sparse pages hold exact counts over huge key sets in memory proportional to the keys present, reserved keys repair lost harmonics, a check prime detects corrupted copies and a per-tick diagonal gives exact age-fading weights; Eliminate learns a parity rule over GF(2) from labelled flag words in one shot, and PleromaKernel.Graded builds the sign-graded operator tower on the flag cube and reports the type of the algebra it generates; several primes per cell and an optional fading complex component are supported. RelationFace reads the holonomy of any loop of stored relations in one linear read and the exact circulation direction of a loop of rational rates, and ChargeLattice reads integer charges from the carries of a periodic lattice's loop sums, with an exact merge law. CycleHologram is the keys-only special case (exact multiset, replica reconciliation by subtracting holograms). KeyedSummary holds exact counts and 128-bit sums per dense key: add and remove rows, all-or-nothing batches, merges, a one-pass fold through a key-to-group map, exact top-k by sum, count or mean from block bounds the summary keeps itself, pre-grouped group totals that stay exact as facts arrive and as keys change groups, and checksummed persistence on a hardware CRC-32C (Crc32C). Beneath both, the phasor Vector Symbolic Architecture (VSA) codec: bind, unbind, bundle and correlate over unit-complex faces, with a frozen-identity codec for models and a width-configurable SIMD codec for storage and similarity search.
title: Phasor
